metadata.description: Workflow skills for coding agents. Vibe fast, own the result.

plugins.name: agent-skills-kit
plugins.description: Nineteen workflow skills for coding agents (develop, debugging, code-review, verification, intake, spec, research, and more). Hooks route each prompt to one skill, announce the workflow risk, and keep a review reminder open until review evidence arrives, while a git guard blocks destructive git commands. A Sonnet worker runs the workflow skills; read-only reviewer, auditor, and researcher subagents report back.
